full_prompt_en: A square muted-green anime landscape shows a white-haired traveler sitting quietly on a mossy rock beside a stream, facing a steep wooded bank. The foreground rock occupies the lower center and right, with dark green moss, small blades of grass, and irregular stone edges. The seated figure is near the center but small within the frame, seen from behind and in slight left profile. Short pale hair catches the available light, while an olive-brown loose outer layer covers the shoulders and dark trousers fold beneath a cross-legged posture. Hands rest near the lap; the person appears still and absorbed in the view. A pale turquoise stream runs horizontally behind the rock, its calm surface marked by a few thin white highlights. Beyond the water, a sloped bank fills most of the middle and upper image with layered gray-green stone and soft vegetation. Fine sketchlike lines trace the stone's diagonal fractures. At the upper right, a gnarled tree root twists out of the slope, supporting low branches that carry clusters of pale yellow-green leaves across the top. Narrow hanging stems and darker shaded crevices add detail without breaking the quiet open space around the traveler. The light is soft and filtered through the foliage, brightest on the upper leaves, pale hair, and water, while the root hollows and foreground moss stay deep green. Thin contours and translucent washes allow rock, branch, and water to merge gently into a humid atmosphere. The palette is restrained to sage, olive, moss, cream, and a little cool turquoise. There is no readable text. The overall composition is calm and contemplative, using a low seated figure and arcing canopy to frame a simple moment beside the water.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形低饱和绿色动画风景呈现一名白发旅人静静坐在溪边苔石上，面朝陡峭林岸。前景石块占据下方中央和右侧，带深绿色苔藓、细小草叶和不规则石缘。坐者靠近中央，却在画幅中显得很小，从身后和略偏左的侧面入镜。短浅色头发接住可用的光，橄榄棕色宽松外衣覆盖肩膀，深色长裤在盘坐姿态下折起。双手停在腿边，人安静地沉浸于景色。浅青绿色溪流在石后水平经过，平静水面有少数细白高光。水的彼岸，斜坡占据画面中上部大多数区域，由层叠灰绿石头和柔软植被组成。细密草图般线条描出岩石的斜向裂纹。右上方一条扭曲树根从斜坡长出，撑着较低枝条，把浅黄绿色叶丛伸向画面顶部。狭窄垂茎和较深的阴影裂隙增加细节，却不打破旅人周围的安静空处。光柔和地经枝叶过滤，在上方树叶、浅发和水面最亮，树根空洞与前景苔藓保持深绿。细轮廓与半透明淡彩让石、枝和水轻轻融入潮湿空气。配色限制在鼠尾草绿、橄榄绿、苔绿、奶油色与少量冷青绿。没有可读文字。整体构图平静而沉思，以低位坐者和弯曲树冠框住水边简单一刻。
style_prompt_en: The quiet anime landscape uses restrained sage, olive, moss, and pale turquoise washes, with thin sketchlike contours beneath the color. Layered organic shapes and diagonal stone-like marks make depth without crisp photographic separation. A small dark focal form rests near a low horizontal band, surrounded by generous muted midtones and an arcing upper canopy. Filtered light picks out pale edges and leaves most recesses in soft green shadow; the result is gentle rather than high contrast. Branching lines, roots, and hanging threads add intricacy mainly at the edges, preserving an open calm center. Grain and translucent pigment variation keep the surfaces tactile. The overall effect is meditative and humid, with modest scale, muted color, and delicate linework carrying the mood.
style_prompt_zh: 这种安静的动画风景用克制的鼠尾草绿、橄榄绿、苔绿与浅青绿淡彩，颜色下保留细薄草图轮廓。层叠有机形状和斜向石纹般笔痕建立纵深，而没有清晰的摄影式分隔。小而深色的焦点形体停在低位水平带附近，被宽裕的低饱和中间色和上方弯曲枝冠包围。过滤的光挑亮浅色边缘，让多数凹处保留柔软绿影；效果温和而非高反差。分枝线、根脉与垂丝主要在边缘加入精细度，保留安静开阔的中心。颗粒与半透明颜料变化使表面可触。整体效果冥想般而潮湿，低调尺度、收敛颜色与细腻线条承载气氛。
theme_en: A white-haired traveler seated beside a green woodland stream
theme_zh: 白发旅人坐在绿色林间溪水旁
name: Mushishi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
